adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the constructed evt sets destinationCalendar to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exist (`... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events it tries to add team members' calendars via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op, so any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are never added, meaning the event won't be created on those team members' destination calendars.
